
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lost0/p/21266049" title="发布于 2026-07-08 21:51">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">GBA开发-01:搭建开发环境</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>OS： windows10， 搭建过程使用了AI</p>
<p>1.下载&nbsp;<a class="Link--primary Link" href="https://github.com/devkitPro/installer/releases/tag/v3.0.3" data-view-component="true" data-turbo-frame="repo-content-turbo-frame" rel="noopener nofollow">devkitPro Updater&nbsp;</a>,这里有3.0.3版本， 2026/07/07,这个时间点的最新版本</p>
<p>&nbsp; https://github.com/devkitPro/installer/releases/download/v3.0.3/devkitProUpdater-3.0.3.exe</p>
<p>2.安装DevkitPro</p>
<p>&nbsp; 只需要选择GBA环境即可，安装到&nbsp;C:\devkitPro (默认目录，改了路径可能会导致有些地方报错)，国内网络的原因可能需要多试几次</p>
<p>&nbsp; 安装完成后</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/5704/202607/5704-20260708205139518-739186273.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>3.安装vscode</p>
<p>下载地址 https://code.visualstudio.com/</p>
<p>下载后双击安装，一直下一步，直到安装完成</p>
<p>需要安装以下扩展：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/5704/202607/5704-20260708210052984-1727623358.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>4.下载模拟器，用于测试开发的GBA程序</p>
<p>https://mgba.io/downloads.html</p>
<p>&nbsp;https://github.com/mgba-emu/mgba/releases/download/0.10.5/mGBA-0.10.5-win64.7z</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>5.测试开发环境</p>
<p>用vscode打开&nbsp;C:\devkitPro\examples\gba\template 文件夹，这里是一个sample程序</p>
<p>打开后这个样子</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/5704/202607/5704-20260708213719684-1437359073.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;其中，需要手动添加.vscode文件夹，并在.vscode文件下添加以下4个文件</p>
<p>c_cpp_properties.json&nbsp; &nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">{
    "version": 4,
    "configurations": [
        {
            "name": "GBA",
            "compilerPath": "C:/devkitPro/devkitARM/bin/arm-none-eabi-gcc.exe",
            "intelliSenseMode": "gcc-arm",
            "cStandard": "gnu11",
            "includePath": [
                "${workspaceFolder}/source",
                "${workspaceFolder}",
                "C:/devkitPro/libgba/include",
                "C:/devkitPro/devkitARM/arm-none-eabi/include"
            ],
            "defines": [
                "__GBA__",
                "ARM7"
            ]
        }
    ]
}
</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>launch.json ，注意，这里配置的gba模拟器的路径，用于直接启动mGBA模拟器测试我们开发的程序</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">{
    "version": "0.2.0",
    "configurations": [
        {
            "name": "Run mGBA",
            "type": "cppvsdbg",
            "request": "launch",
            "program": "C:/dev/Emulator/mGBA-0.10.5-win32/mGBA.exe",
            "args": [
                "${workspaceFolder}/template.gba"
            ],
            "cwd": "${workspaceFolder}"
        }
    ]
}
</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>settings.json</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">{
    "files.associations": {
        "*.h": "c"
    },
    "editor.tabSize": 4,
    "editor.insertSpaces": true,
    "C_Cpp.default.configurationProvider": "ms-vscode.makefile-tools"
}
</pre>
</div>
<p>　</p>
<p>tasks.json</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">{
    "version": "2.0.0",
    "tasks": [
        {
            "label": "Build GBA",
            "type": "shell",
            "command": "make",
            "args": [],
            "group": {
                "kind": "build",
                "isDefault": true
            },
            "problemMatcher": [
                "$gcc"
            ]
        },
        {
            "label": "Clean",
            "type": "shell",
            "command": "make",
            "args": [
                "clean"
            ]
        }
    ]
}
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　</p>
<p>最后 Makefile要复制到 C:\devkitPro\examples\gba\template　，否则编译时报错</p>
<p>6. 在source文件下有一个template.c， 按ctrl+shift+b 来编译程序</p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp;控制台会输出以下内容</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/5704/202607/5704-20260708215608477-624344492.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;按 F5，会运行模拟器并加载开发的gba程序 ，如图</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/5704/202607/5704-20260708215751274-1732489065.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>到这里，开发环境搭建完成&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

</div>
